title: Small project for Quick Sorting your Photos
excerpt: I have years of accumulated photos on my phone, and I wanted to build a simple project that can help me quickly sort them to organized files, labelling them by year and place. So I built a simple project called Photo Quick Sorter that takes in a folder of photos and allows you to quickly sort through them by keybinds or buttons.

title: Small project called SafeName
excerpt: I like to save papers with their actual titles, but sometimes it will have characters that are not allowed in file names. So I built a simple terminal app called SafeName that takes in a string and replaces all the characters that are not allowed in file names with underscores.

title: The AI Boom or the Human Bust? — Data Visualization Project
excerpt: Built a D3.js scrollytelling experience exploring AI’s dual impact on global growth and job disruption, integrating multiple coordinated visualizations with smooth interactions and narrative-driven design.

title: Our Paper Accepted into CIKM '25
